data.body: User authorized parallel background implementation for up to five file-disjoint leaves. Runtime capacity is four total agents, so orchestration is using three isolated worker worktrees plus the root lane. Current conflict-free claimed batch: internal-chargeable-turtledove (8 src/rebar/_cli paths), scrawny-ingenious-civet (18 core unit-test paths), and classy-bicolor-owl (5 infrastructure paths). Workers are limited to comments/docstrings/documentation, scoped validation, and clean commits; they must not push, submit, close, or self-author the independent receipt. Gerrit push/CI/submit remains serialized. Current foreground change 2798 has LLM-Review +1 and CI run 34160080699 still in progress; local make verify remains waived by explicit user instruction in favor of Gerrit Verified CI.
